summary: Six of seven success criteria are met. Criterion 1 fails: the on-disk global install at ~/.claude/skills/setup-with-claude/SKILL.md is still the old three-tool version (header reads 'Three tools'; zero matches for --uninstall, integrations.json, or aaw-routing). The smoke report claims the file was refreshed byte-identically in loop-003, but direct file inspection contradicts this. All other criteria are met: the meta-source SKILL.md has correct --refresh (R2/R3/R5) and --uninstall (U3/U7) sections, SETUP.md and SKILL.md both carry the hook-restart caveat, the runtime phase-goals-agent at ~/.claude/agents/phase-goals-agent.md declares Write, advanced-planning main HEAD is fa799d3, and the smoke report marks findings #1-#5 resolved/documented with phase-2 references.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: ~/.claude/skills/setup-with-claude/SKILL.md is the 4-tool version: grep -c for --uninstall, integrations.json, and aaw-routing each return ≥1; header no longer says "Three tools".
criteria_outcomes.evidence: C:/Users/mharvey2/.claude/skills/setup-with-claude/SKILL.md line 12 reads 'Three tools integrate at boundaries to form a complete pipeline:'. grep for --uninstall, integrations.json, aaw-routing each return 0 matches. This is the old pre-phase-2 version. The meta-source at .claude/skills/setup-with-claude/SKILL.md (in the repo) is correct (32 combined matches for the three patterns; header says 'four-tool integration'), but the global deploy was not updated despite the smoke report claiming it was.

criteria_outcomes.evidence: C:/Users/mharvey2/.claude/agents/phase-goals-agent.md line 5: 'tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Write'. Write is present. This agent successfully wrote its verdict file directly (no main-thread contingency required).
